name: Eviction Defense Collaborative
description: Free eviction defense and legal help for San Francisco tenants
fullDescription: The Eviction Defense Collaborative is the lead organization for San Francisco's Tenant Right to Counsel program, providing free legal help, rental assistance, and shelter advocacy to keep people housed.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free legal help and representation for tenants facing eviction (Tenant Right to Counsel)
- Help responding to unlawful detainer lawsuits and notices to quit
- Rental assistance for tenants behind on rent (RADCo)
- Shelter Client Advocacy for people at risk of losing a City-funded shelter or transitional housing placement
- Tenant rights workshops and education
howToGetIt:
1. If you got a Summons & Complaint or a notice to quit, call the legal assistance line at 415-659-9184 or email legal@evictiondefense.org
2. Or drop in at 976 Mission Street (Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri: 10–11:30 AM and 1–2:30 PM)
3. Bring your eviction notice and any court papers
4. For shelter issues, call Shelter Client Advocacy at 415-669-0284
5. General questions: 415-947-0797
keywords: eviction defense, San Francisco, tenant, unlawful detainer, housing court, free lawyer, renter, landlord, eviction notice, EDC
